title: Wendell and the Cover
author: Wendell Coldharbour
blurb: Beatrix Coldharbour, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
